summary: The root WZN relates to weight. A "wāzin" object is heavy or of full, complete weight, like a "dirham wāzin" which is a full-weight dirham.
lane: وَازِنٌ ذ : see رَاجِحٌ : heavy: (Msb:) or of full weight: (KL:) pl. وُزَّنٌ : see زَالٌّ . You say, دِرْهَمٌ وَازِنٌ (S) A full, or complete, dirhem: (so in a copy of the S:) [ a dirhem of full weight: a heavy dirhem. (PS.)
